articles.title: Gomez injury overshadows winning start for Iraola
articles.summary: Liverpool start life under Andoni Iraola with a 4-2 win over Sunderland thanks to goals from Kieran Morrison, Dominik Szoboszlai, Federico Chiesa and Lewis Koumas.

articles.title: England women ramp up Rugby League World Cup preparations with win in France
articles.summary: England women ramped up preparations for the Rugby League World Cup in their mid-season international against France on Saturday, with a dominant performance in Toulouse.
